reviewer_role: Independent AI peer. I personally read the complete supplied source and target text and the category and rationale of every retained triple. Author reading claims and mechanical pin checks were not substituted for this reading. No human, scholarly, Hebrew, Greek, or critical-apparatus review is claimed.
complete_text_policy: The helper complete_text was used throughout, including any continuation_paragraphs. Original reference labels and the twelve suffix units were individually preserved and their full bodies personally read.
pin_verification_scope: All twelve retained/candidate source and target books were freshly fetched as raw pinned files into unique peer-independent artifacts, with Git blob SHA, raw SHA256, and full parsed cache equality verified. This mechanical provenance work contributes no textual reading or completion credit.

refinement_review.assessment: Accepted. Narrowed peace/festival wording, Levite-specific and Passover-specific targets, removal of the unsupported law-record link, cautious Daniel wording, the Jeconiah prophetic target, and the newly read Ezra proclamation parallels all improve the final packet.

deferred_source_units.reason: I read the post-deliverance gifts and Hezekiah's international honor with 32:22-24. No particular target was established in this pass; this remains a source-only deferral, not a generic royal-honor connection.
I read the produce-storage, animal-manger, and flock-fold wording with 32:27-29. The neighboring royal wealth material does not by itself establish a specific counterpart to these arrangements.

I read Manasseh's wall route, Gihon, gate, Ophla, and garrison assignments with 33:13-15. No precise geographical or construction counterpart was established; no assumed wall identification is retained.

I read the exact assertion that Josiah's deeds and hope were written in the Lord's law, its surrounding 35:25-27, and the removed comparison with 35:19b. The latter is a law-obedience assessment rather than an identification of the cited record, so this source remains deferred.

unresolved_candidates.reason: The Chronicles unit explicitly names Jehoiakim as the shedder of innocent blood. In Kings, the pronoun follows the notice about Manasseh's sins. The final judgment clauses also differ: unwillingness to destroy versus unwillingness to be propitiated. The proposed direct attribution parallel remains unresolved and unretained; the retained Jeremiah comparison does not erase these differences.

Chronicles names the successor Jechonias and gives three months and ten days. The supplied Kings sequence calls both father and successor Joakim and gives three months. Shared age and evil assessment do not resolve the personal-name issue, so this proposed direct regnal-identity target remains unretained.

Chronicles calls the installed king the preceding king's father's brother, whereas Kings calls Maththanias his son before the renaming as Sedekias. The supplied kinship statements are not harmonized. This proposed direct identity-and-kinship target remains unresolved and unretained.

semantic_observations: All retained relationships and rationales have a specific textual or contextual basis. Same-chapter explanatory connections are expressly identified and not treated as external parallels.
The source-specific numbering is retained, including Jeremiah 36 for the deportation letter and all twelve separately numbered suffix bodies; no conventional reference numbering is substituted.

The final rationales preserve the one-versus-one-hundred gold tribute in 36:3 and the conflicting maternal names and parentage in 36:5. They also preserve other explicit name, wording, and death-sequence differences rather than repairing the source.

The Daniel connection claims the shared conquest and temple-vessel events without resolving its third-year chronology against the fuller Chronicles sequence. The Ezra comparison preserves the original after-fulfillment and purpose-of-fulfillment wording in the actual evidence.

All three proposed Kings identity/attribution/kinship links remain unretained and receive zero additional completion credit. Their source units are supported separately by the retained, personally read targets.
completion_definition: Initial curated supported cross-reference pass, not exhaustive discovery. Each retained range counts once. All 153 actual source units were personally read, while only 149 supported source units and 165 retained pairs receive completion credit. Four source-only deferrals and three unresolved target candidates receive zero completion credit.
